objectives.description: Land ht_le_of_reflTransGen (rank non-decreasing along forward reachability)
Land raise_subtree helper (downward cascade over a chosen Finset of direct neighbours, well-founded on Set.ncard {q in G.X | ht q >= ht p})
Assemble boxI_lift itself: ancestor walk from x to the root via cs5FCIncest_raise (F2), invoking raise_subtree for sibling branches at each level
objectives.note: Landed via siblings_disjoint + boxI_lift_ancestor (Finset-exclusion ancestor-walk induction) + boxI_lift (thin excl:=∅ wrapper). One documented correction to the transcribed schema: the exclusion-membership check in the edge conjunct is on the edge's target, not source (source-side is unprovable at the boundary edge into the excluded branch, since cs5FCIncest has no raise-source-only-keep-target-exact conjunct). Sorry-free, axiom-clean.

approaches_tried.approach: Ancestor-chain + downward-cascade decomposition using raise_subtree as the downward piece, with the outer ancestor-walk induction hypothesis stated as "covers all of G's edges unconditionally" and applied directly at each ancestor via ihn
approaches_tried.reason: The unconditional induction hypothesis at ancestor q would freely re-derive the value of the child branch we came from (via its own internal raise_subtree call), which need not match the already-pinned target value fixed for that branch two levels down. Diagnosed via live lean_goal before writing any further code; not a math wall (F1/F2/unique-parent/graded-rank all still sufficient) -- purely an induction-hypothesis-shape engineering issue, fixed by adding a Finset exclusion parameter (see plan Phase 7 note for the exact corrected statement).

approaches_tried.approach: Finset-exclusion ancestor-walk induction (boxI_lift_ancestor), checking the exclusion antecedent via the edge's source (a), exactly as the dispatch-1 handoff's schema transcribed it
approaches_tried.reason: Unprovable at the boundary edge into the excluded branch (ancestor edge q->z: a=q outside the excluded closure, b=z inside it) -- would require r(raised q)(old ρ z), and cs5FCIncest has no raise-source-only-keep-target-exact conjunct. Corrected to check via the edge's target (b) instead, which vacuously drops exactly the boundary edge (handled separately by the caller's own cs5FCIncest_raise fact). Documented in boxI_lift_ancestor's docstring; not a re-opening of the overall strategy.
